'''Du Hutta''' was a terrestrial<ref name="CSWE Jocoro" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Du Hutta system/Legends|Du Hutta system]], a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Irith system/Legends|Irith]] and [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Du Hutta was a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and featured numerous private retreats owned by Hutts from the species' adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In addition, less prominent members of several Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] maintained estates there.<ref name="TEA" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="CSWE Jocoro" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jocoro Desilijic Tiure]] operated a small criminal enterprise from a base on Du Hutta,<ref name="CSWE Jocoro" /> and the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] former [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]] eventually came to serve the Hutt faithfully there.<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Du Hutta was first mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article written by [[Rich Handley]] and included in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider67" /> which was published on [[March 28]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
